mentions.name: Pipipie (casual math game)
mentions.description: A casual math game for Android built around simplicity and accessibility, letting people play easy math challenges to pass time. Currently available on Android with plans to expand to other platforms.
mentions.problem: Simple, accessible games that people can play just to spend time are scarce, particularly for players with limited mobility.
mentions.audience: People looking for simple, accessible games to spend time with, including players with limited mobility.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I recently launched a casual math game!

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=pipipie.game

It's currently only available on Android but I hope to bring it to other platforms soon.

I am a disabled developer who has limited mobility in his arms. I like treating games that are simple and accessible for people just to spend time.
